protocol: One exemplar box per kept question, drawn by a human on the released image. Box one clearly visible, unoccluded instance of the object the question asks about, tight to its visible extent. Never box a group, a part, a reflection or a picture of the object. If no clean instance exists, mark no_clean_instance; the question is then excluded from the conditioned evaluation with that reason. AI-suggested boxes are never approved boxes.
coordinates: box_px: continuous source pixels (x0, y0, x1, y1) of the released image; box_source_unit: box_px / (w, h, w, h); box_letterbox_unit: counting.letterbox_frame(w, h).boxes
